items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: Old man Shao Ney. He learned white in color too. He was a good old teacher. ... You had to wait till you make your chords, or hum the notes. ... You had hum the notes for him, you understand?

ctx.x: Well, you come from, you know, come from school sometime. I wasn't there two bits to go play. I lied to my aunt and went to music lessons. Same time I didn't go. He's right there on St. Gloria Street. Old man Shao Ney. He learned white in color too. White in color. He was a good old teacher. See, if I pick up a horn, yeah, I take it. Used to get you like that, Nicky, concert time. One, two, three. Make it sing your notes. First piece of music I learned how to play, when the same go march in the middle of my God…
What do they call him again?
